sections.title: At the Beach
sections.content_text: Warm Up Look at the picture. What do you see? Talk about any 3 of them. Cloud Palm Tree Sea Ball Girl Swimming Ring Sand Starfish Sandcastle Read and Enjoy Let us read what Varun and his sister do when they visit a beach with their family. It is a lovely day. Varun and his sister Vidya are at a beach with their Hey, let us build a sandcastle. Sure! I have a shovel and a bucket too. Varun and Vidya build a castle together. Look, this room is for Grandpa and Grandma. Wow! They will tell us stories here. Varun and Vidya build a very big castle. This room is for Mummy and Daddy. And that one is our playroom. We can keep all our toys here. Where does this staircase go? It goes to the basement. We can play hide-and-seek there. Nobody will find us  there. Mom and Dad are calling. We have to leave now! Glossary shovel : a tool for digging earth. basement : rooms or wide space below the ground floor of a building staircase : a set of stairs in a building

I live in  _______. My birthday  is on ____________. Grammar Vowels and Consonants There are 26 letters in the English alphabets. These letters can be divided into  vowels and consonants. The five letters a,e,i,o and u in the red circles are called  vowels . The rest of the twenty – one letters are called consonants. Z U T O X A B I J W E b. Write the name of your friend. Circle the Consonants. _________________________________________________ Vocabulary Word forming Ability: Joined Words Read these words. sandcastle = sand + castle	  staircase = stair + case Words that are made up of two smaller words are called Joined words.
